title: Poori
description: Puffed, golden deep-fried wheat breads that are the traditional partner for aloo sabzi, chole or halwa.

ingredients.name: Vegetable Oil
ingredients.notes: about 30 ml for the dough, the rest for deep frying

steps: Mix the atta, sooji and salt, then rub in about 30 ml of the oil.
Add the water gradually and knead a stiff dough; cover and rest for 20 minutes.
Divide into 16 small balls and roll each into a 4-inch round, lightly oiling instead of dusting with flour.
Heat the frying oil until a pinch of dough rises immediately.
Slide in one poori, press it gently with a slotted spoon so it puffs, and fry for about 20 seconds per side until golden.
Drain on paper and serve hot.
